# PCMCI_industrial -- Final Results

**PCMCI** on **Industrial (TEP)**. Generated by `tools/write_final_results.py` from this folder's `outputs/`; every figure below is read from the files the run wrote, never transcribed.


## Detection performance

The threshold is the 95th percentile of the fault-free score distribution, computed without reference to any attack label. AUC-ROC is the primary metric because it is threshold-free; F1 is reported at that fixed operating point and is only comparable against other rows measured the same way.

| Variant | TP | FP | TN | FN | Precision | Recall | F1 | AUC-ROC | AUC-PR |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Linear / Ridge | 12536 | 40 | 756 | 3384 | 0.9968 | 0.7874 | **0.8798** | **0.8860** | 0.9940 |
| Polynomial degree 3 | 12598 | 40 | 756 | 3322 | 0.9968 | 0.7913 | **0.8823** | **0.9151** | 0.9956 |
| RBF + Ridge | 11738 | 40 | 756 | 4182 | 0.9966 | 0.7373 | **0.8476** | **0.8495** | 0.9920 |

Best by AUC-ROC: **Polynomial degree 3** at **0.9151**, over 16716 evaluated samples.

These values match the other two algorithms on this dataset. Only the causal discovery method and the regression type differ across folders; see the root `README.md` section 6.

| 4 | Reactor cooling water inlet temperature, step | `XMV_10` | `XMV_10` | yes |
| 5 | Condenser cooling water inlet temperature, step | `XMV_11` | `XMV_11` | yes |
| 7 | C header pressure loss | `XMV_4` | `XMV_4` | yes |
| 11 | Reactor cooling water, random variation | `XMV_10` | `XMEAS_20` | no |
| 14 | Reactor cooling water valve sticking | `XMV_10` | `XMEAS_9` | no |

**3 of 5 faults localised to the exact variable named in the fault specification** (linear variant, top-ranked attribution only). Detection strength and root-cause specificity are separate properties and do not have to agree.


## Reproducing

```bash
cd PCMCI/PCMCI_industrial
python anomaly_detection.py
python anomaly_detection_polynomial.py
python anomaly_detection_rbf.py
```

The first run learns and caches the causal graph; later runs reuse it. Delete the `.npz` cache to force rediscovery. The scripts refuse to run against a cache whose resampling rate disagrees with the code, so a stale cache fails loudly instead of reporting metrics for a pipeline that no longer exists.
